lines.japanese: あー……。
lines.english: Ugh...

lines.japanese: 頭が痛い。
lines.english: My head hurt.

lines.japanese: ついでに喉も痛い。意識がはっきりしてくると体も痛い。ああ、カケルくんが珍しくラリアットなんてしてきたからなあ。
lines.english: My throat hurt too. As my head cleared, the rest of my body began to ache. Right—Kakeru had even thrown an uncharacteristic lariat last night.

lines.japanese: 痛かったけど、嫌じゃなかった。楽しかったなあ、昨日のカラオケ。
lines.english: It had hurt, but I hadn't minded. Last night's karaoke had been fun.

lines.japanese: 帰ってきたのは朝方だった。玉泉だけは終電があると言って途中で帰ったけど、他の面子は最後まで馬鹿騒ぎして一晩を過ごした。
lines.english: I had come home near dawn. Tamaizumi alone left partway through to catch the last train; the rest of us spent the whole night making idiots of ourselves.

lines.japanese: 今まで別々に過ごしてきた俺たちの生活が、一人の俺として馴染んできてる。もう試験運用なんて言わなくてもいいだろう。
lines.english: The lives we had once lived separately were settling into the life of a single *me*. I didn't need to call this a trial run anymore.

lines.japanese: 今日もそんなカンジでアゲてこうアゲてこう。楽しい毎日を送るために今日は……。
lines.english: Let's ride that high today. Keep it up, keep it up. And to make sure every day stayed fun, today I would...

lines.japanese: とりあえず学校は休みだし、明日もゆっくり起きればいいから工事現場の方に顔を出してみるか。
lines.english: School was out today, and I could sleep in tomorrow too. Maybe I ought to show my face at the construction site.

lines.japanese: アレキサンダーは連絡を入れて休ませてもらおう。カラオケの次の日に休むってのもカンジ悪いが、現場に出るとしたら体力が持たん。マスターが掛け持ちってのを理解してくれてるし、甘えちゃおう。
lines.english: I would call Alexander and ask for the night off. Taking leave the day after karaoke looked bad, but if I worked the site as well, my body wouldn't last. The boss knew I was juggling two jobs. I could lean on his goodwill this once.

lines.japanese: 向こうはそれほど頼りにされてるわけじゃないけど、ヒゲ監督には散々面倒みてもらってるし、あのプリン頭たちに逃げたと思われるのも癪だ。
lines.english: It wasn't as though the site desperately needed me, but the bearded foreman had done plenty for me. And I couldn't stand the thought of those pudding-heads deciding I'd run away.

lines.japanese: 決まりだ。俺は体を起こして、小鳩に今夜の予定を伝えにいくことにした。
lines.english: That settled it. I hauled myself upright and went to tell Kobato my plans for the evening.

lines.japanese: そういえばお腹も空いたなあ。朝食をとるには絶好の腹具合だ。
lines.english: Come to think of it, I was hungry too. Exactly the right sort of hungry for breakfast.

lines.japanese: 冷蔵庫に寄り道して適当に漁ろうかとも思ったけど、小鳩が朝食を用意してくれてるだろうから、そちらをまずいただいてからにしよう。
lines.english: I thought about detouring to the refrigerator and scavenging whatever I found, but Kobato had probably made breakfast. Better eat that first.

lines.japanese: そう思って居間に近づいたら、中からテレビの音がする。
lines.english: As I approached the living room, I heard the television inside.

lines.japanese: あ、いやこれはテレビからの声だけじゃなくて、生の声……？
lines.english: No, wait. That wasn't only the television. There was a real live voice in there too...

lines.japanese: 入る前に小さくふすまを開けて中の様子を窺ってみた。
lines.english: Before going in, I slid the door open a crack and peeked inside.

lines.japanese: 「まあ、見てくださいこの指輪。素敵ですねー、こんな指輪プレゼントされちゃったら、女性はみんなクラッときちゃいますよねー」
lines.english: “Oh, just look at this ring. Isn't it beautiful? Any woman who received a ring like this would go weak at the knees.”

lines.japanese: 「あ、またこのひとだ。いつもおんなじこと言ってる」
lines.english: “Oh, her again. She always says exactly the same thing.”

lines.japanese: 「でもこのひと人気あるんだって。お父さんもファンだよ」
lines.english: “But I heard she's popular. My dad's a fan too.”

lines.japanese: 「えー、吉川さんのお父さん恐そうなのにすごーい」
lines.english: “Really? Your dad looks so scary, Yoshikawa. Wow.”

lines.japanese: ああ、吉川さんか。何度か見たことあったな、そういえば。
lines.english: Ah, Yoshikawa. I had seen her a few times before, now that I thought of it.

lines.japanese: 見た目が小鳩より若干大人びてるのは生意気だが、うちの妹を友達に選ぶなんてなかなか人を見る目のある少女だ。
lines.english: It was cheeky of her to look a shade more grown-up than Kobato, but any girl with the sense to choose my sister for a friend couldn't be all bad.

lines.japanese: 「羽田さんのお兄ちゃんは、この女のひと好きじゃないの？」
lines.english: “Haneda, doesn't your big brother like this woman?”

lines.japanese: 「んー、お兄ちゃんとそういう話はあんまりしないな……」
lines.english: “Hmm. I don’t really talk to my brother about things like that...”

lines.japanese: 「えー、でもお兄ちゃんいるだけいいよー。いいなー、私もお兄ちゃん欲しー。羽田さんのお兄ちゃんかっこいいし、頭よさそうだし、優しそうだもんね」
lines.english: “Still, just having a big brother must be nice. I wish I had one. Yours is handsome, and he looks smart, and he seems so kind.”

lines.japanese: 「あやっ、そ、そんなことないよ！？」
lines.english: “Huh!? Th-that's not true!”

lines.japanese: いいぞ吉川、もっと言え。
lines.english: That's it, Yoshikawa. Keep talking.

lines.japanese: 俺は一度冷蔵庫に引きかえして、戸棚からお菓子を出して、ついでに少し高い葉っぱを使ってお茶を淹れた。国賓級のお迎えをせねばなるまい。
lines.english: I retreated to the kitchen, brought out snacks from the cupboard, and brewed tea with leaves a little pricier than usual. Nothing less than a state reception would do.

lines.japanese: 「最近はゆとり教育が問題になって、学校教育の見直しが取りざたされていますねえ。ゲストの横障子先生はどう思われますか？」
lines.english: “The so-called ‘relaxed education’ policy has come under fire recently, and calls to rethink our schools are drawing attention. Professor Yokoshoji, our guest today, what do you make of it?”

lines.japanese: 「ゆとりってどんな教育かな？」
lines.english: “What kind of education is ‘relaxed education’?”

lines.japanese: 「うーん、甘やかし教育ってことだから、冬にマラソンとかしなかったりするのかも」
lines.english: “Hmm... It means they go easy on you, so maybe you don't have to run marathons in winter.”

lines.japanese: 「え、それはうらまやしい」
lines.english: “Oh. I'm envinous.”

lines.japanese: 「あれっ？　うらやましい？　うらまやしい？　どっち？」
lines.english: “Wait. Is it envious? Envinous? Which one?”

lines.japanese: 「えっ？　あ、ええと……辞書、辞書見ればわかるよ」
lines.english: “What? Um... the dictionary. We can look it up in the dictionary.”

lines.japanese: 俺は自らの妹を憎まず、現代社会の教育を憎んだ。くそっ、文部科学省め、うちの妹とその大切な御学友をよくも……！
lines.english: I bore no grudge against my own sister. I blamed the educational system of modern society. Damn you, Ministry of Education! Look what you've done to my sister and her dear friend...!

lines.japanese: 「辞書、私の部屋かも」
lines.english: “The dictionary might be in my room.”

lines.japanese: 「うーん、羽田さん自慢の羽田兄が来てくれれば教えてくれるのに」
lines.english: “Hmm. If that amazing Brother Haneda of yours came in, he could tell us.”

lines.japanese: 「は、羽田兄はいいのっ。自分たちで解決しないなんてゆとりだよ。そう、ちょおゆとり」
lines.english: “W-we don’t need Brother Haneda! Getting somebody else to solve it for us would be the lazy way out. That’s, like, the ultimate in relaxed education.”

lines.japanese: 「羽田兄さーん、羽田さんが困ってまーす」
lines.english: “Brother Hanedaaa! Haneda needs heeelp!”

lines.japanese: 「なにっ、大丈夫か小鳩！　ちなみに『うらやましい』でシクヨロ」
lines.english: “What!? Are you all right, Kobato? The word is *envious*, by the way. Kthx.”
“Huh?”

lines.japanese: 「なあんてね。いらっしゃい。はいこれ、お菓子とお茶どうぞ」
lines.english: “Kidding. Welcome. Here—have some tea and snacks.”

lines.japanese: 「あ、お兄ちゃんおはよー」
lines.english: “Oh, morning, big bro.”

lines.japanese: 「え、ええええっ！？」
lines.english: “Wh-whaaaat!?”

lines.japanese: 「久しぶり、羽田兄です。いつも妹と仲良くしてくれてありがとう。可愛いでしょ、うちの小鳩。あ、べつに俺シスコンとかロリコンとか全然ないけどね」
lines.english: “Long time no see. Kobato’s brother at your service. Thanks for always being such a good friend to my sister. Our Kobato’s adorable, isn’t she? Not that I’m obsessed with my sister or attracted to little girls. Not at all.”

lines.japanese: 「ああの、お、お邪魔してますっ」
lines.english: “U-um, s-sorry to intrude!”

lines.japanese: 「俺もみかん食べる食べるー」
lines.english: “I want a tangerine too! Me too!”

lines.japanese: 俺は小鳩の友達の隣りに座って、もぞもぞとこたつに足を入れた。無邪気な兄を装いつつ、小鳩の友達がうちの妹にふさわしい人間かどうか見極めてやるぞくくく。
lines.english: I sat beside Kobato's friend and wriggled my legs beneath the quilt of the heated table. While playing the guileless big brother, I would judge whether this girl was fit company for my little sister. Heh heh heh.

lines.japanese: この時期の友達ってのは重要だからな。渡来や玉泉みたいな凶暴なのと付き合ってたら、うちの可愛い小鳩がとんだ雌豚、略して羽田小豚になってしまう。お兄ちゃんがおまえを守ってあげるよ小鳩。
lines.english: Friends mattered at her age. Hang around with brutes like Watarai and Tamaizumi, and my darling Kobato might become a dreadful little sow—a Haneda Piglet, for short. Big Brother will protect you, Kobato.

lines.japanese: 「お兄ちゃん、みかん食べすぎると指が黄色くなるよ」
lines.english: “Big Brother, if you eat too many tangerines, your fingers will turn yellow.”

lines.japanese: 「えっ？　ひゃあっ、私もう黄色い……」
lines.english: “What? Eek! Mine are yellow already...”

lines.japanese: 「え、見せて見せて」
lines.english: “Really? Show me, show me.”

lines.japanese: 「は、恥ずかしいからヤです」
lines.english: “N-no! It's embarrassing.”

lines.japanese: 「ええー、そんな恥ずかしがらずに、もっとフランクに接しようぜー。ほらほら、みかんもっと食べてよ。イエローフィンガー・トゥギャザーだよほらほら」
lines.english: “Aw, don't be shy. Let's loosen up with each other. Here, have another tangerine. Yellow Fingers Together! Come on, come on.”

lines.japanese: 「あ、あああ、ありがとです。でももう充分いただきました」
lines.english: “Th-th-thank you. But I've really had enough.”

lines.japanese: うーん、奥ゆかしくて良い子だなあ吉川さん。渡来や玉泉とは雲泥の差だ。よし合格。妹との交遊を許可しちゃうぞ。
lines.english: Hmm. Yoshikawa was a sweet, modest girl. Worlds apart from Watarai and Tamaizumi. All right, she passed. I hereby permitted her to associate with my sister.

lines.japanese: 「羽田さんいいなあ、こんな優しいお兄さんがいてうらまやしい」
lines.english: “You're so lucky, Haneda. Having such a kind brother—I'm envinous.”

lines.japanese: 「うらやましい」
lines.english: “Envious.”

lines.japanese: 「そそ、そうですた」
lines.english: “R-right. That's what I sayed.”

lines.japanese: 性格はいい子だけど、お勉強の方は残念な子なのかもしれない。
lines.english: A good-hearted girl, though perhaps not much of a scholar.

lines.japanese: でも吉川さんの慌て方って小鳩に似てるな。類は友を呼ぶってやつか。つまりとっても可愛いうちの小鳩に似てるってことは、吉川さんもとっても可愛いってことになる。よし合格。
lines.english: But the way Yoshikawa panicked reminded me of Kobato. Birds of a feather, was that it? Which meant that if Yoshikawa resembled my unfathomably adorable Kobato, she too must be unfathomably adorable. All right, she passed.

lines.japanese: 「ははは、そんな畏まらなくていいんだぞう。いつもクラスではこんなカンジ？」
lines.english: “Ha ha ha. No need to stand on ceremony. Are you always like this in class?”

lines.japanese: 「いえ、普段はもう少し落ちついて話せます、お兄さんがいきなり現れたもので、私焦っちゃって」
lines.english: “No, I can usually talk a little more calmly. You appeared out of nowhere, so I panicked.”

lines.japanese: 「ああ、友達の家族がいきなり出てきたらびっくりするよね。ごめんごめん」
lines.english: “Of course. Anybody would be startled if their friend's family popped out of nowhere. Sorry, sorry.”

lines.japanese: 「そ、そんなことないですよ、くすっ」
lines.english: “N-no, it was nothing. Hee hee.”

lines.japanese: 「で、さっきの質問に戻すけど、小鳩はクラスだとこんなカンジ？」
lines.english: “Anyway, back to my question: is Kobato always like this in class?”

lines.japanese: 「ああああー、すみませんすみません、私てっきり自分のことを聞かれたのかと……」
lines.english: “Aaaah! I'm sorry, I'm sorry! I was sure you were asking about me...”

lines.japanese: 「えっ、私いつもと変わらないよね？」
lines.english: “What? I'm the same as always, aren't I?”

lines.japanese: 「そうかあ？　いつもよりフランクな感じがするぞ」
lines.english: “Really? You seem more relaxed than usual.”

lines.japanese: 「どこが？」
lines.english: “How?”

lines.japanese: 「テレビ見て楽しそうにしてるトコとか」
lines.english: “Like how you're having fun watching TV.”

lines.japanese: 「それって普通だよ」
lines.english: “That's perfectly normal.”

lines.japanese: 「あれ？」
lines.english: “Huh?”

lines.japanese: そう……だっけ？　俺とはあんまりテレビ観て楽しそうになんて……ん？　あるか？
lines.english: Was it...? She rarely seemed to enjoy watching television with me... Wait. Did she?

lines.japanese: 「でも、普段よりよくしゃべる気がする」
lines.english: “Still, I feel like you're talking more than usual.”

lines.japanese: 「お兄ちゃんと話してるときと変わらないよ」
lines.english: “It's no different from when I'm talking to you.”

lines.japanese: 「あれ？　そうだっけ？」
lines.english: “Huh? Is that so?”

lines.japanese: 昨日の朝を思い出してみた。ホントだ。
lines.english: I thought back to yesterday morning. She was right.

lines.japanese: なんだ、俺が勝手にそう思いこんでただけか。
lines.english: Oh. So I had simply convinced myself otherwise.

lines.japanese: 「もー、お兄ちゃんヘンなの」
lines.english: “Honestly, big bro. You’re being weird.”

lines.japanese: そうか、今までは俺と話してたんじゃないもんな。小鳩から見たタカシや鷲介は、親戚のお兄ちゃんみたいに見えてたはずだ。
lines.english: Until now, she hadn’t been talking to *me*, after all. To Kobato, Takashi and Shusuke must have seemed more like older cousins than her own brother.

lines.japanese: 「そっか。そかそか」
lines.english: “I see. I see, I see.”

lines.japanese: 「うん？」
lines.english: “Hm?”

lines.japanese: 時間ならいくらでもあるんだ。これから小鳩と出来るだけたくさん話をしようと思った。
lines.english: We had all the time in the world. From now on, I would talk with Kobato as much as I possibly could.

lines.japanese: 「いや、おかしなことを言ってすまなんだ。さあみかんでも食べよう」
lines.english: “No, forgive me. I said something strange. Come, let us eat tangerines.”

lines.japanese: 「うんっ」
lines.english: “Mm!”

lines.japanese: 「い、いただきます」
lines.english: “I-I'll have one.”

lines.japanese: 「ほんとだ、吉川さんの指がまっ黄色」
lines.english: “You're right. Yoshikawa, your fingers are bright yellow.”

lines.japanese: 「ああああー」
lines.english: “Ahhh!”

lines.japanese: 和むなあ。このふたり。渡来や玉泉とは（略）
lines.english: These two were so soothing. Unlike Watarai and Tamaizumi, who—[abridged].

lines.japanese: しばらく俺はほっこりして過ごした。
lines.english: For a while, I simply sat there in the warmth of it all.
